# Agentforce / GenAI Reference Index — captured 2026-07-07

APIs: Agent API, Models API (Apex + REST), Testing API, Citations API, Metadata API, Tooling API.
SDKs: Agentforce Python SDK, Agentforce Mobile SDK (iOS/Android).
Other: Agent Script (agent-building language, now GA), Agentforce DX (pro-code),
Lightning Types Reference (custom UI for agent actions), Metadata Types, Tooling Objects.

No dated/new APIs on the reference index page itself. Summer '26 (via WebSearch):
Agent2Agent (A2A) open-protocol support for delegating to third-party agents;
API v67.0 defaults SOQL/SOSL/DML to user mode + Apex "with sharing";
Named Query API GA; Agent Builder API; Salesforce-hosted MCP servers GA. [REPORTED 2026-07-06]

New since 2026-07-06:
- Agentforce Commerce agents (Shopper/Buyer/Merchant) GA with catalog sync to ChatGPT
  (via Business Manager) and Google Search/AI Mode + Gemini app integration (coming
  summer 2026). [REPORTED 2026-07-07]
